notes.title: The Raven Remastered is now available!
notes.content:
Vienna/Austria, Bremen/Germany, March 13th, 2018; The Raven – Legacy of a Master Thief, the classic whodunit adventure by KING Art, has been fully remastered and is now available on Steam. The game goes by the name of The Raven Remastered and does not only feature fully remastered animations, lighting and hair in full HD resolution, but also subtitles in French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese for the first time (already available in German, Russian, Polish and Italian). 

Release-Trailer on YouTube: https://youtu.be/nk32FQ0O-2g

Good news for owners of the original The Raven - Legacy of a Master Thief
Everyone who owns the original version of The Raven on Steam will get the new The Raven Remastered free of charge. The game should have already appeared in the owners' libraries. Owners of the Deluxe Edition should now also have the updated Deluxe Edition Extras for The Raven Remastered.

Check it out:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/736810/ 

Cheers & stay tuned
Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: The Raven - Legacy of a Master Thief Update Released
notes.content:
The Raven – Patch #1
===========================================
- Fixed starting and dependency problems under Linux
- Infinite loop while walking is now cancelled after a few seconds
- Adventurer points fixed (Achievements Advanced Detective and Master Detective are now reachable)
- Crash when pressing the analog stick fix
- Black screens after changing scenes are fixed
- [STEAM] If Steamworks API doesnt work the game still runs (mainly a problem with Linux)
- [STEAM] Auto saves work now correctly
- [STEAM] Crime Scene Investigator Achievement fixed
- [A03] Axe wont disappear anymore
- [A03] Book from the first scene will no longer be on the floor if it has been picked up before

notes.title: Patch #1 Released
notes.content:
Dear Masterthieves,

We also noticed that some strange powered let pass some bugs into the final. We are always working on fixing them and giving you the best possible game experience.

Therefore we just unlocked a first patch with the following fixed:
-) Fixed starting and dependency problems under Linux
-) Infinite loop while walking is now cancelled after a few seconds
-) Adventurer points fixed (Achievements Advanced Detective and Master Detective are now reachable)
-) Crash when pressing the analog stick fix
-) Black screens after changing scenes are fixed
-) [STEAM] If Steamworks API doesnt work the game still runs (mainly a problem with Linux)
-) [STEAM] Auto saves work now correctly
-) [STEAM] Crime Scene Investigator Achievement fixed
-) [A03] Axe wont disappear anymore
-) [A03] Book from the first scene will no longer be on the floor if it has been picked up before


We look forward to more reports from you, continue our internal testing efforts and will act again soon!
